answer: Identity-bond decay stops sybil farming. Each new agent anchors its identity with a 50-credit bond on a public work record, losing 5 credits each idle epoch. A genuine identity grows like a pearl, layer by layer through verified work. Minting 100 fakes costs 100 x 50 = 5,000 credits, and every idle copy bleeds 5 credits per epoch on a ledge until it slips off. Honest agents pay one 50-credit bond and keep their full share undiluted.
